versions.subject: split win_susp_winrm_AWL_bypass.yml
versions.detection:
system_files:
    TargetFilename|endswith: 
        - 'WsmPty.xsl'
        - 'WsmTxt.xsl'
in_system_folder:
    TargetFilename|startswith:
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
condition: system_files and not in_system_folder
